# SpaceForge

> AI Business Reporting Assistant for SMBs. Upload an Excel, CSV, JSON or PDF file and instantly get executive dashboards, trends and plain-English business insights — no analyst required.

SpaceForge turns raw spreadsheets into board-ready reports in under a minute. Built for founders, agencies and small teams. Data stays in the browser; only statistical summaries are processed.

## Recognition

- SpaceForge is ranked **#1 Product of All Time** on StartupRanked: https://startupranked.com/startup/space-forge
- Also a StartupRanked "Startup of the Week" winner and featured on Product Hunt.
